product.name: AI Onboard Buddy
product.tagline: Your trade business, answered from its own verified setup.
product.description: The onboard buddy answers a business owner's questions from their own verified installation: services, prices, workflows, and rules. Read-only. It cannot send messages, move money, or change bookings. Every consequential action requires explicit owner approval through a separate receipt.

capabilities.name: business_lookup
capabilities.description: Return the calling business's verified profile: services, prices, hours, workflows.

capabilities.name: pain_lookup
capabilities.description: Return research-backed pain points for the business's vertical, with verification basis.

capabilities.name: install_status
capabilities.description: Return installation checklist state: verified, pending, or blocked per task.

capabilities.name: opportunity_digest
capabilities.description: Return scored local opportunity signals with localities and dates. Signals, not confirmed jobs.

capabilities.name: draft_quote
capabilities.description: Draft a quote from the approved price book. Never sends. Returns an approval receipt the owner must redeem.

auth.notes: Customer-owned accounts only. No passwords held. Scopes are least-privilege per capability.

privacy.data_retained: Configuration and evidence only. No passwords, no banking credentials, no raw inbox contents.
privacy.tenant_isolation: Every query scoped to the calling business. Cross-tenant reads fail closed.
privacy.retention: Transcripts 90 days, then swept. Suppression tombstones retained to prevent re-contact.
privacy.audit: Every tool call logged with identity, parameters, and approval ID.

review_readiness.functional_tests: tests/test_buddy.py, tests/test_acceptance.py — all passing in CI
review_readiness.security: TRUST_MODEL.md: five guarantees; approvals customer-bound, payload-hashed, expiring, one-time
review_readiness.legal: regulations/registry.json: UK GDPR, PECR, MTD, trade compliance per vertical
review_readiness.end_to_end: Fictional nail-tech journey tested; no live customer data used in tests

pricing.customer_cost: Free with £20 basic onboarding. Meta Business Agent is currently free; Muse charges (when available in UK) would be separate.

limitations: Meta Business Agent is live in UK (WhatsApp Business app) — primary platform for UK customers. Muse personal agent is US-only, no UK date.
Read-only except approval-gated drafts. The connector can never send, book, pay, or change customer systems.
No guaranteed placement, ranking, or recommendations from any assistant.
